title: Model Runtime & Tools
summary: This module manages the core machine learning runtime for model inference and text generation, and integrates external tools and web services to extend model capabilities.

nodes.label: ML Backends & Operations
nodes.title: Core ML Runtime & Operations
nodes.description: Manages the fundamental machine learning operations, including tensor manipulations, KV cache for efficient state, and the end-to-end text generation pipeline.

nodes.label: External Tools & Web Integration
nodes.title: External Tools & Web Services
nodes.description: Integrates external web search capabilities and browser-like tools, managing their dispatch and interaction with external web services to enhance model functionality.

nodes.label: LLM Inference Requests
nodes.title: Incoming Inference Requests
nodes.description: Requests originating from the API or other application modules to perform language model inference, such as text generation or embeddings.

nodes.label: Tool Invocation Requests
nodes.title: Requests to Execute Tools
nodes.description: Requests from the language model or other components to execute specific external tools, often triggered by tool-calling capabilities.

nodes.label: Generated Text Output
nodes.title: Model Generated Text
nodes.description: The primary text output produced by the language models after processing inference requests.

nodes.label: Tool Execution Results
nodes.title: Results from External Tools
nodes.description: The data or outcomes returned by external tools after they have been executed, which can then be fed back into the LLM.

nodes.label: External Web Services/APIs
nodes.title: Third-Party Web Services
nodes.description: External services, such as search engines or other APIs, that the integrated tools interact with to fetch data or perform actions.

groups.label: Core ML Runtime
groups.title: Core Machine Learning Runtime
groups.description: This group encapsulates the fundamental components responsible for executing machine learning models, managing their state, and generating output.

groups.label: External Capabilities
groups.title: External Tool Integration
groups.description: This group manages the integration and dispatch of external tools and web services, extending the capabilities of the language models.

groups.label: System Interactions
groups.title: Interactions with Other Systems
groups.description: This group represents the various inputs and outputs that flow into and out of the module, connecting it with other parts of the application and external services.
